job: Bring the parcel at the kerb up the driveway to the front door
understood_as: Pick up the small parcel at the kerb and bring it up the driveway to the front door.
steps: Pick up the small parcel at the kerb.
Carrying it up the driveway and setting it down at the front door is not planned yet, because the planner cannot route to the front door.

demos.why: Shows how the hand approaches and lifts a small box standing on its long edge.
Shows how firmly to grip a cardboard box so it neither slips nor gets crushed.

questions: The front door is not a located spot in the building, so the robot cannot be sent to it. Can the front door be located or marked in the scan?
Is the parcel the small box (20 x 15 x 6 cm, about 0.6 kg)? If it is a different size or weight, please give the weight or add an object card for it.
unmet: Carrying the parcel up the driveway and putting it down at the front door is not covered, because the planner can only deliver to the way out.
